prompt: Build a 4-qubit circuit implementing, as a general-purpose circuit block: Hadamard on all 4 qubits, then the phase exp(-i*gamma*H) where H = 0.4 * Z0 * Z1 + 0.6 * Z1 * Z2 * Z3 (one two-body term plus one three-body term). gamma = 0.5 — the SAME target as the standard ising_mixed_body_4q task. IMPORTANT constraint: use ONLY the gates RZ, SX (square-root-X), X, and CX. Do NOT use H directly — decompose it into this gate set. No measurement.
